values.note: Camping rates for 2026: RV site with water and electric, 30-amp $35/night, 50-amp $45; weekly $215/$275, monthly $650/$750; rustic tent site $25; cabin site $55. A 4% Madison County occupancy tax is added to every reservation. Pump-outs $15 (free for weekly and longer stays).

note: Bouckville (US-20), hilltop valley views. Hosts the Madison-Bouckville antique shows (early June and mid-August). Daily, weekly, monthly and seasonal campers welcome. --Claude
summary: Confirmed the 2026 rates ($35 30-amp / $45 50-amp W/E, weekly and monthly too), water and electric at every RV site (50-amp the highest), showers, free Wi-Fi, laundry, dump and pump-out; added season May 15 - Oct 15 and online booking through parkwith.us. Closed for the 2026 season ('See you in 2027'). Note trimmed of field facts. Not stated: site count, lengths; sewer left derived false.
